title: ZALM Source Simulation
description: Discrete-event NetSquid simulation of a Zero-Added-Loss Multiplexing (ZALM) entangled-photon source, with the code, configuration and result data behind the figures of Horgan et al., Advanced Quantum Technologies (2026), doi:10.1002/qute.202500810. Runs standalone (NetSquid only) or as a QSI component.
